name: Search Members/Subscribers
description:
Searches for a subscriber. The search can be restricted to a specific list, or can be used to search across all lists in an account.
   [See docs here](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/search-members/)

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description: A string list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

configurable_props.name: excludeFields
configurable_props.label: Exclude Fields
configurable_props.description: A string list of fields to exclude_fields. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

configurable_props.name: query
configurable_props.label: Query
configurable_props.description: The search query used to filter results. Query should be a valid email, or a string representing a contact's first or last name.

configurable_props.name: listId
configurable_props.label: List ID
configurable_props.description: The unique ID for the list.
